user.title: JiaChao Smart Light
user.description: Login with your JiaChao app account (phone number + password). Leave device UUID empty (auto-generated; first login requires an SMS code, afterwards no more); advanced users can paste the device UUID captured from their own app to skip the SMS step.

code.title: SMS verification
code.description: JiaChao server requires verification of a new device. A code has been sent to your phone; enter the 6-digit SMS code:

device.title: Select device
device.description: Found {total} JiaChao device(s) ({supported} supported). Select the one to connect; entries marked "not yet supported" need packet capture before their protocol can be added.

error.invalid_code: Incorrect or expired code, please try again
error.code_send_failed: Failed to send code (possibly rate-limited, try later)
error.device_unsupported: This device model is not yet supported (currently only the dual-color-temperature light). Report it via project Issues, or provide captured traffic for this model to extend support.
